fee_notes: Base Minimum Initial Franchise Fee $49,900 for territory 100,000-150,000 Target Households. Additional territory $0.40/Target Household. Range reflects actual fees paid by franchisees in 2025 including discounts: Roll-In (5-50%), Multi-Unit (10-25%), VetFran (20%), HIRE (10-25%), Additional Concept (10%), Community Heroes (up to 10%). Only VetFran may reduce below $49,900; discounts cannot be combined.
